vo.text: What **$1 billion** earns while you watch this.
There goes an hour at minimum wage.
4% of $1 billion is $40 million a year.
That's how many seconds it takes.
It earns an hour of median pay every **≈ 25 seconds**.

notes: Rate: $1,000,000,000 × 4% = $40,000,000 a year ÷ 31,536,000 s (365 days) = $1.268392 a second (≈ $1.27). Counter over 27.0 s: 1.268392 × 27 = $34.2466 → ≈ $34.25. Pass times = value ÷ 1.268392: Costco hot dog + soda $1.50 (unchanged since 1985) → 1.18 s (≈ 1.2 s); federal minimum wage $7.25/hr (since July 2009) → 5.72 s (≈ 5.7 s); median pay $1,251 a week (BLS Q2 2026, the series' yardstick) ÷ 40 hrs = $31.275 (≈ $31.28) → 24.66 s (≈ 24.7 s, so an hour of median pay every ≈ 25 seconds). Swap-in rule: your hourly pay ÷ 1.27 = the seconds it takes.
